clue.text: Where the figurehead is left, hungrily pacing

parts.note: a ship's figurehead is carved at the front, on the prow

explanation.surface: A ship's figurehead has been abandoned while someone paces about hungrily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Where the figurehead is' reads like a question of location; it is a three-word phrase giving most of the answer before L is added.
explanation.definitionFit: A predator searching for prey is said to be prowling, moving about restlessly and hungrily.

clue.text: Standard question at baptism, followed by name

indicators.note: followed by says the name piece comes after the baptism piece

parts.note: in the Book of Common Prayer the first question, What is your Name?, is answered N or M
Al is a man's name

explanation.surface: A standard question asked at a christening, followed by the child's name.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Prayer Book catechism and baptism service the name is printed as 'N. or M.', a placeholder.
explanation.definitionFit: Normal means conforming to the usual standard.

clue.text: Report of Sherlockian paronomasia lacking embellishments

indicators.note: report of says we hear the phrase spoken rather than written

parts.note: a pun made by Sherlock Holmes, a Holmes pun

explanation.surface: An account of a detective's wordplay delivered plainly.
explanation.walkthrough: Paronomasia is the formal word for punning.
explanation.definitionFit: Something plain and unsophisticated, like rough handwoven cloth, lacks embellishment.

clue.text: Doctor reproduces routine operations

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters of the next word are altered

explanation.surface: A doctor repeats the usual surgical operations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' and 'operations' suggest surgery; Doctor is a verb, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Procedures are established ways of doing things, routine steps.

clue.text: Lawrence initially joins musical drama to perform in theatre

parts.note: an opera is a musical drama
T E were the initials of Lawrence of Arabia

explanation.surface: Lawrence starts a career in musical theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' suggests the first letter L; it means T.E. Lawrence's initials.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons operate in an operating theatre.

clue.text: Pulls in listeners

definitions.meaning: to drag or haul something heavy

explanation.surface: Someone attracts an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: Lugging is hauling; lugs is also informal for ears, the organs that listen.

clue.text: Zephyr makes a quarter turn

parts.note: west is one of the four quarters of the compass
to wind is to turn

explanation.surface: A gentle breeze swings round through ninety degrees.
explanation.definitionFit: Zephyrus was the Greek god of the breeze from the setting sun.

clue.text: Roses for dry soil?

parts.note: seems to suggest flowers that tolerate drought, but a rose is the perforated nozzle on a watering can or hose

explanation.surface: A gardener asks which roses suit a parched bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Garden devices spray water through perforated heads, also called roses.

clue.text: Take a backward look first at university maintenance

indicators.note: first says the university piece comes before the rest

parts.note: being up means being in residence at university

indicators.note: backward says the word for a look is read from right to left

parts.note: a peek is a quick look

explanation.surface: Someone glances back before starting on the upkeep of a college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take a backward look' tempts you to reverse a whole phrase; only the word for look turns, and 'first' sets the university word ahead of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Upkeep is the cost or work of keeping something in good repair, which is maintenance.

clue.text: Flower in border with spore scattered around

indicators.note: around says the rearranged letters go round the word for border
scattered says the letters of spore are strewn into a new order

parts.note: a rim is an edge or border

explanation.surface: A flower in a garden border is surrounded by drifting spores.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scattered' makes PROSE from the spore letters, and 'around' wraps that round the border word.
explanation.definitionFit: The primrose is a pale yellow spring wildflower.

clue.text: As a poet, a follower of Dante

definitions.text: As a poet, a follower of Dante

parts.words: As a poet, a follower of Dante
parts.note: seems to describe a disciple of the Italian Dante Alighieri, but means the poet Christina, younger sister of the painter-poet Dante Gabriel of that surname

explanation.surface: A poet is described as a disciple of the great Italian Dante.
explanation.walkthrough: Dante Gabriel and Christina were Victorian siblings; Christina, the poet, followed Dante in birth order, not in literary allegiance.
explanation.definitionFit: Christina Rossetti, poet of Goblin Market, was the younger sister of Dante Gabriel Rossetti.

clue.text: Minor error in margin on book

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece on another means it comes after it

parts.note: a lip is an edge or margin

explanation.surface: A small mistake sits in the margin of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A blip is a small, brief deviation or glitch, a minor fault.

clue.text: Head can do nothing wrong? Express one's affection

parts.note: a bill is a headland, as in Portland Bill

indicators.note: wrong says the letters of can do with the zero are out of order

parts.note: O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A boss who can do no wrong is the object of affection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' rearranges CANDO plus O into ANDCOO.
explanation.definitionFit: Lovers who bill and coo whisper endearments like courting doves.

clue.text: Demand prestidigitation to achieve one's purpose

definitions.meaning: an order to a conjuror to perform a piece of sleight of hand
to be effective or bring about the desired result

explanation.surface: A request for conjuring that also means succeeding.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense reads the phrase literally, as a command to a magician.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that works or succeeds is said idiomatically to accomplish what was needed.

clue.text: The people round Derby, for example, or part of London

definitions.text: The people round Derby, for example
definitions.meaning: the Earl of Derby is a nobleman, and those attending him form his court
a district of west London known for its exhibition centre

explanation.surface: A Derby crowd, or a district of the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Derby is an earldom, not the town or race.
explanation.definitionFit: Earls Court is an area of Kensington; an earl's retinue is his court.

clue.text: The French getting wet in the washroom

parts.note: la is the French feminine definite article
wet means not dry, written here as un-dry

explanation.surface: A Frenchwoman gets soaked in the washroom.
explanation.walkthrough: UNDRY is a whimsical construction for wet: not dry.
explanation.definitionFit: A laundry is a room or building where clothes are washed.

clue.text: In broken sun, composer is working out

indicators.note: In says the composer goes inside the broken letters
broken says the letters of sun are rearranged

parts.note: Maurice Ravel was a French composer

explanation.surface: A composer sits in fractured sunlight, figuring something out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' makes UNS from the sun letters; 'In' puts the French composer inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: Unravelling a mystery is solving it, working it out.

clue.text: Cook, in a way, holds key to puzzle

parts.note: G is a musical key
a riddle is a puzzle

explanation.surface: A cook hides the solution to a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'key' is a musical key, not the answer to a puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: To griddle food is to cook it on a flat iron plate, one method of cooking.

clue.text: Make a detour round the centre of Paisley and drive out

indicators.note: round says the detour word goes around the central letters

parts.note: to dodge is to swerve aside

indicators.note: the centre of picks the middle three letters of the word Paisley

explanation.surface: A driver detours round central Paisley and gets away.
explanation.walkthrough: Paisley is a town in Scotland; 'the centre of' takes its middle three letters, and 'round' wraps the detour word about them.
explanation.definitionFit: To dislodge is to force out of position, to expel.

clue.text: One may go up and down on the catwalk

definitions.text: One may go up and down on the catwalk

parts.words: One may go up and down on the catwalk
parts.note: seems to describe a model walking up and down the runway, but means the edge of a skirt rising and falling with fashion

explanation.surface: A model parades up and down the runway.
explanation.definitionFit: The bottom edge of a skirt rises and falls with fashion trends.

clue.text: It soars — she circulates

indicators.note: circulates says the letters of the preceding words move around into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An aircraft climbs while a woman moves among the passengers.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the plane soars, and the stewardess circulates down the aisle.
explanation.definitionFit: A stewardess flies with the plane and walks about the cabin serving passengers.

clue.text: Drops Silver on board ship

indicators.note: on board says one piece is carried inside the ship

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Silver coins are dropped aboard a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Sags and drops both mean sinks or falls lower.

clue.text: Threaten to go out in the Channel

definitions.meaning: a candle flame flickers as if about to die
a trough along a roadside for rainwater

explanation.surface: Something nearly extinguished in the English Channel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the Channel' suggests the sea between England and France; it is a drain.
explanation.definitionFit: A candle flickering low gutters; a gutter is a drainage channel.

clue.text: Sort of joint that spells trouble after check on party

indicators.note: in an across answer one piece on another comes after it
after says the trouble piece follows the others

parts.note: a do is a party
to vet is to check
to ail is to be troubled or cause trouble

explanation.surface: A carpenter's joint causes trouble after inspection at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spells trouble' looks like a noun phrase but is a verb: AIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A dovetail is a woodworking joint of interlocking wedge-shaped tenons.

clue.text: Greek god Roman gods don't start to equal

indicators.note: don't start says the opening letter is dropped

parts.note: the lares were Roman household gods

explanation.surface: A Greek god is claimed equal to Roman ones.
explanation.definitionFit: Ares was the Greek god of war, Mars to the Romans.

clue.text: Overwhelm one woman in order to get old hat

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a nun is a woman in a religious order
to date is to become old-fashioned

explanation.surface: A woman joins a religious order to obtain an antique hat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' looks like 'so as to', but belongs with 'woman': a member of a religious order.
explanation.definitionFit: To inundate is to flood or swamp, so to overwhelm.

clue.text: Like the world of a religious devotee

definitions.meaning: the earth is a sphere slightly flattened at the poles, a shape geometers name with this word
a lay person dedicated to a monastic life

explanation.surface: A description of the shape of the earth that also names a devotee.
explanation.definitionFit: An oblate spheroid is flattened at the poles, as the globe is; an oblate is also a layman dedicated to religious life.

clue.text: Western ferment about art lover

indicators.note: about says one piece goes round the Western piece

parts.note: to seethe is to be in a ferment
taken as written

explanation.surface: A western excitement over art captivates an art lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'art lover' looks like one phrase; the definition is only 'lover'.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweetheart is a beloved, a romantic partner.
